headline: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright told supporters of data centres to push back against critics, saying their concerns are overblown, in a speech on 30 Jun 2026.
score_reason: Lowered from 6 to 4: this is a 30 Jun 2026 Reuters story republished with a 16 Oct 2026 date, so it is not new.
importance_line: It shows a federal cabinet member openly siding with data centre builders against local opposition, which matters to residents and local governments, but the statement is from June and nothing in this item is new.
summary: Reuters reported on 30 Jun 2026, as carried by the Hawaii Tribune-Herald, that US Energy Secretary Chris Wright urged data centre supporters at an Amazon Web Services conference to push back against critics, calling concerns about water, power, jobs and communities 'overblown' and likening the fight to opposition to fracking. The same story reappeared on EnergyNow.com dated 16 Oct 2026, so it is older news and not a new statement.
